messages:
deploy-bot: rollout finished: v2.13.1 -> canary-usw2. initiating post-deploy smoke suite (healthchecks, synth probes, kvprobe). dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/r/rollouts/1759254321 :rocket:
mira: quick heads-up: synth probe for /gen returned elevated tail latencies and a couple 502s around 1759254350. small sample but consistent trend. :thinking_face:
david: can you paste the synth output?
mira: ```
[1759254348] synth /gen -> 200 latency=420ms trace=tx-cc33
[1759254349] synth /gen -> 502 upstream_error model=redwood-embed-3
[1759254350] synth /gen -> 200 latency=610ms trace=tx-cc34
```
oliver: trace sampler shows increased kernel selection fallback at same window. maybe new quant fallback path in v2.13.1?
kai: traffic to canary is 4% overall, /gen route is ~20% of that. not huge.
mira: kvprobe shows a burst of prefix misses then recovery: "kvcache miss rate 0.12 -> 0.45 -> 0.15" around same ts.
deploy-oncall-bot: incident candidate flagged: synth-latency-spike (severity: low). Recommend restricting route if regression confirmed.
david: propose partial pin of /gen to v2.12.10 to buy triage time. anyone object?
oliver: +1. run command to pin when ready.
mira: pinning now: ```redwoodctl routing set --route /gen --version v2.12.10 --percent 100 --reason "postdeploy synth p95 spike"```
deploy-bot: routing change applied by mira at 1759254371. audit r-audit-7921.
mira: after pin, synth p95 back to ~150ms in ~45s. 502s cleared. verifying for 10m.
kai: nice. does this imply a full rollback of v2.13.1?
david: not immediately. this looks specific to the runtime fallback for one model family. cc @serving-ops to validate kernel selection heuristics.
oliver: opening internal ticket: RINF-2345 "v2.13.1 embed runtime fallback investigation" with traces and kvcache heatmap. linking release notes.
deploy-oncall-bot: scheduled check-in reminder in 15m.
mira: action list: mira monitor synth + kvcache for 15m, david collect runtime logs and kernel-selection diffs, oliver create ticket and update release notes, kai coordinate with serving-ops for a patch. If issue recurs or affects other routes we escalate to full rollback.
david: added traces: https://traces.redwood.ai/tx-cc33 and https://traces.redwood.ai/tx-cc34. heatmap attached to ticket.
mira: 10m update: stable so far. leaving thread open for postmortem notes. :white_check_mark:
